gen-gf-tektur-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified, with a steady weight word to word. Tektur sits above it with open curve endings and thread-thin strokes, a display voice that gives the plain text something to push against.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-secular-one: Thread-like strokes and oversized lowercase make Tektur instantly recognizable, with every curve left open at its ends. And Secular One answers underneath with a fat midsection and no stroke variation, a sans body that feels solid beside it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans reads tight and compact, its midline set high and the gaps between letters nearly gone. Smooch Sans is the packed, quiet one; Tektur does the showing off, with strokes like stitched thread and big lowercase.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed has a big x-height, tight ascender room and curves lifted off before they close into loops. Tektur is the one with flair; this plain sans simply gets on with the talking.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-spline-sans-mono: Wiry and technical, Tektur opens every curve and enlarges its lowercase for a look that is hard to ignore. And Spline Sans Mono counters with fixed-width, uniformly bold letters, so the strongest quality here is a machined, code-like precision.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 is tall in the body, which makes its ascenders look short. Over a longer passage the sans text would feel compact and tidy, while Tektur's evenly thick curves keep the heading lively.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-truculenta: Tektur leads with open-ended curves and oversized lowercase that look drawn with wire. Truculenta follows in a crowded, compact sans line with short ascenders and rounded shapes, and that tight friendliness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-ubuntu: Reading Tektur feels like following one thread, with every curve left open at the end and the lowercase oversized. Ubuntu, a sans with a lofty lowercase band, sits beside it in a modern, businesslike way.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-victor-mono: Tektur's curves stay open at their ends, drawn in wire-thin strokes with oversized lowercase. Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and half-open bowls, gives it a structured, precise partner.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-viga: Expressive from the first word, Tektur leaves its curves open and blows up its lowercase. But Viga keeps a long read smooth, a sans with no hairlines or shadows, where capitals barely rise above the rest.
